name: Rod of Shadow Infusion
body:
Price 10,800 gp; Aura moderate illusion; CL 9; Weight 3 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This rod looks like a burned, twisted branch about 2 feet long, it is in fact made of dark metal instead of wood. When activated, the rod emits a shadowy smoke around it for 1 round. As a swift action, usable 3 times per day, the user can convert an illusion spell into a more powerful shadow spell, making them partially real. Any casting of minor image or major image can be converted into a casting of shadow conjuration and any casting of major image can be converted into a casting of shadow evocation.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,400 gp; Feats Craft Rod, shadow conjuration, shadow evocation
